mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 56 degrees under clear skies at Fireman's Park, and we are currently experiencing a New Moon phase.

City officials have released several notices for the upcoming November general election, and the Verona Police Department is encouraging residents to sign up for their Citizen Academy, a free nine-week program covering topics like O W I investigations and crime scene processing.

Today you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, tomorrow features the Dane County Farmer's Market and more music at Paddy Mac's, with the big Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival arriving in town this Saturday.

On Sunday, August 30, the Verona Police Department took a 34-year-old Madison resident into custody following an investigation into an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and student dating back to 2019.
Today's flavor of the day at Culver's is Raspberry Cheesecake. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:30 PM.
